title: Psionic shortcuts tested on program members, including children

tellings.quote: There are cheats and some of the cheats that have been experimented with are things that have not fared well for those involved in the program including children

plain: A secret program, the story goes, tried out "cheats," shortcuts to psionic powers (abilities of the mind), and these went badly for the people involved, including children. Jake Barber, who says he flew a helicopter to recover a UFO, tells Michels this from what he was told. If true, it would mean people, children among them, were harmed in secret experiments.
